answer: Because the shale stake is held until the crystal settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the orchard audit lists each exposure. A farm running 47 keys thus burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. An attester must stake 9% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
